data.body: Held-out validation: implementer reported 3 attempts and saw only the one visible happy-path test. Restored edge/E2E oracle initially produced two whitespace-sensitive false failures; under revert-first discipline I removed the implementation, normalized rendered Markdown whitespace in those tests, reconfirmed all four tests RED for the true missing T15/count behavior, restored the unchanged implementation, and all four passed. Defect-seeded mutation removed the scoped-cleanup contract; the held-out edge test went RED on the missing `only the resources it created` consequence, then GREEN after restoration. Tests assert public explain_guide/CLI output and hand-authored docs, not private structure.
